snapshot.title: XP level-up overlay / celebration
snapshot.description: XP is synced to Supabase but level-ups are silent. Show a brief overlay in the React shell when experience_level increases, e.g. 'Level 2 — Longer range unlocked'.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shell detects experience_level increase from postMessage XP events
Level-up overlay appears briefly then auto-dismisses
Overlay text references what the new level unlocks
